children: Tokenization could free up tens of billions of dollars in capital tied up in assets used as collateral across the global financial system, Nasdaq
CEO Adena Friedman said in a recent interview. Tokenizing assets such as treasuries, equities, and money market funds, along with the flow of money, could make collateral more liquid, Friedman told
CNBC
at the TOKEN2049 conference in Singapore.
“If you tokenize all those instruments along with the flow of money, then the collateral becomes very fluid,” Friedman said.

Tokenization involves representing financial assets, such as stocks and bonds, as digital tokens that can be transferred using blockchain technology. Friedman said institutional interest in tokenization has grown over the past year, pointing in part to the
of the Genius Act in the U.S., which established a regulatory framework for stablecoins.

“If we can tokenize money, then we can tokenize the flow of capital,” she said, according to the report. That growing institutional interest is converging with demand from retail investors, who have long sought the ability to trade around the clock, according to Friedman. The retail ecosystem “has been about 10 years ahead,” she said.
Moving to a fully 24/7 market would be a major undertaking for the financial industry, Friedman said. “The easiest part is the exchange infrastructure,” she said.

Additionally, artificial intelligence could help financial institutions manage that transition. Nasdaq has launched a series of digital agents within its risk management platform that initially provide recommendations, Friedman said. Over time, banks could use those agents to take more direct action, she added.
Companies outside the U.S. are showing interest in tokenization and access to American capital markets, Arjun Sethi, co-CEO of cryptocurrency exchange Kraken, told CNBC.

Sethi pointed to a company generating roughly $25M in revenue that was exploring ways to access capital markets, as well as larger international companies interested in tokenization and U.S. public listings.
Relevant companies to watch in the asset tokenization theme include Coinbase
, Robinhood
, Intercontinental Exchange
, Nasdaq
, Broadridge Financial Solutions
, JPMorgan Chase
, BlackRock
, WisdomTree
, Galaxy Digital
, Figure Technology Solutions
, and Tradeweb Markets
These companies offer varying degrees of exposure to tokenized securities, real-world assets (RWAs), blockchain-based settlement, digital asset trading, and tokenized investment funds.

title: Nasdaq CEO: Tokenization could unlock tens of billions in trapped capital
